description: How long to cook a food, and at what temperature, by method: oven, air fryer, boil, steam, microwave, pan-fry, deep-fry, grill (broil), barbecue, slow cooker, pressure cooker, poach or braise. Covers over 100 foods: vegetables (broccoli, carrots, sprouts, asparagus, corn on the cob, butternut squash…), potatoes and chips, chicken breasts, thighs and wings, steak, burgers, mince, pork chops, sausages, bacon, lamb chops, salmon, cod, prawns, eggs, rice, pasta, halloumi, tofu and frozen food such as oven chips, nuggets and fish fingers. Gives the time for a typical portion, the temperature (°C, fan, °F, gas mark), how to do it, how to tell it is done and the safe temperature for meat and fish. Leave out the method to get every method for that food.

food.description: The food, in plain words, e.g. "broccoli", "chicken thighs", "frozen chips", "salmon", "boiled eggs".

method.description: Optional: oven, air fryer, boil, steam, microwave, pan, deep fry, grill, barbecue, slow cooker, pressure cooker, poach or braise. Plain words like "roast", "Instant Pot" or "stir-fry" work too.

name: food_cooking_time
title: Cooking time for any food and method
